segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Thanks for calling support, this is Maya. How can I help?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Hi Maya, this is Ben at Northlake Packaging. We need to add 8 seats to our account before Monday, if possible. We're at 42 today and want to go to 50.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Yeah, I can help with that. Can you confirm the billing contact email and the last four digits on the payment method?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Sure. Billing contact is ap@northlakepackaging.com, and the card ends in 1842.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Perfect, thanks. I have the account pulled up in the admin console and billing tool. You're on the annual Business plan through March 31, 2026. Adding 8 seats today will prorate at $1,248.00 before tax for the rest of the term. Is that approved?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yes, that's approved. Please go ahead.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Okay, the 8 seats are added. Your account now shows 50 total seats, and I see 8 available to assign. The prorated invoice, INV-47291, was sent to ap@northlakepackaging.com just now.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Great. Do I need to do anything special to assign them?

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: No, same process as usual. Go to Users, click Add user, and assign the role. If you're uploading a CSV, the template in the knowledge base is current. The new seats are available immediately.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Perfect, that's all I needed. Thanks for the quick help.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: You're welcome. I also added a note to ticket 318744 confirming the seat increase and invoice number. Have a good one.
